Coverage: January 2023 to 30 September 2026. Row dates are the lab's first public announcement or release; where a preview and general availability differ, the row uses the first public date and date_note gives the other.
Dates given as YYYY-MM (no day) could not be pinned to a day from a primary source: see rows with a seven-character date.

Parameter counts are null for every closed model and wherever no official figure was found. For dense models active equals total. For family rows (Gemma, Gemma 3, Llama 2, Llama 3, OLMo 2, Qwen2.5) the counts are the largest published size; Llama 4 uses Maverick; DeepSeek V4.1-Flash uses the 16B decode figure (8B in prefill).

Sakana Fugu and TypeSafe Jev are included because the page discusses them, but neither is a language model in the usual sense (Fugu is an orchestrator over other models); filter them out of a model timeline if needed.
Step 5 Preview is open_weights false: weights are promised for 2026-10-15 with no licence named, and none were on Hugging Face as of 2026-09-30.
Grok-1 is dated to its 2023-11-03 chatbot launch; its 314B MoE weights were released under Apache 2.0 on 2024-03-17.

Several rows cite Wikipedia or secondary reports (DataCamp, unite.ai, llm-stats, MarkTechPost, Neowin) where the lab page was unreachable (openai.com returned 403) or undated; primary sources were used wherever they could be fetched.

Licence names for some older models (DeepSeek License for LLM 67B to V3, Tongyi Qianwen License for Qwen1.5-MoE, Qwen License for Qwen2.5-72B, Phi-2 MIT, Aya Expanse CC-BY-NC) were not all confirmed against the original release pages.
